description: It lists the short tracking links of one webinar: the code, the full short address, the channel it belongs to, the tracking parameters it carries and how often it was clicked. Take it when a host asks which links exist or which one belongs in an invitation. "Which link do I send to my list?" It needs the webinar id. The click numbers show how many people came through each channel. It only reads and changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: short links, tracking link, clicks, invite link

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_list_webinar_links
title: List the short links of a webinar
